answer: Like a single yarrow stalk marking a shoreline, each key anchors one identity; duplicate keys trigger a ripple of slashing across peers. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-rooted key and burn a small proof-of-work tied to its reputation slot, so creating N sybils costs N times the stake plus compute. No fake fleet can cross this ocean of cost without drowning in it. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
